itens.titulo: Flickering Hound: Five Ways to Use It in Commander
itens.resumo: A card like Flickering Hound will impact Commander games in plenty of ways - Alejandro explores four good ways and one not so good way.
You've wiped everyone's board but your own, then your commander gets removed. Who really had the fun removed from the game?

itens.titulo: The Salty Cards EDHREC Writers Refuse to Face
itens.resumo: From Rhystic Study to Grave Pact, EDHREC's writers name the Commander cards that make them saltiest, with stories from games that went wrong.
